Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Enabled_tooltip: When off, explosions behave exactly as they do in vanilla and hurt only characters.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Doors_tooltip: Blasts damage doors. \n A fence gate goes down easily, a locked security door needs a pipe bomb at point-blank range.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Windows_tooltip: Blasts shatter windows. Range is larger than breaking furniture or doors
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_PlayerBuilt_toolt: Blasts damage carpentry and metalwork raised by players - walls, gates, barricades. \nTurn this off on a server where charges could be used to breach bases.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Furniture_tooltip: Blasts blow apart furniture that could have been dismantled or carried away, drops scrap.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_FencesAndProps_to: Blasts bend and flatten fences, and wreck the roadside clutter cars can already flatten - signs, posts, meters, light fixtures. \nWeak fences are blown away from the charge; a close hit smashes them outright.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_BreakWalls_toolti: A big enough blast turns eligible walls into burned versions, which can be climbed through. \nRequires at least a pipe bomb.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_DropScrap_tooltip: Wrecked furniture and fences drop the planks, nails and metal they were made of. \nTurn this off so destroyed objects drop nothing.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_BlastPower_toolti: Scales all structural damage, as a percentage. \nDefault is 100 at which pipe bombs destroy security doors point blank, at 0 nothing is destroyed
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_BlastRadius_toolt: Scales how far the damage carries, as a percentage of the explosive's own range. \nThis stretches the shockwave without making the charge itself any stronger.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Falloff_tooltip: How sharply damage drops off with distance. \nHigher concentrates the destruction on the tiles nearest the charge; lower spreads it evenly across the whole radius. Default 4.0.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_FurnitureToughnes: How much furniture is damaged for each point of its carrying weight, so a wardrobe always resists far more than a chair. \nHigher means sturdier. Default 6.0.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_CharThreshold_too: How much blast energy a tile must take before its walls break through. \nLower makes charring common, higher confines it to the center of the explosion. Default 0.53, which is the energy that breaks a security door.
